name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Coagulant Surge Patch
description:
The Coagulant Surge Patch is a single-use topical trauma device designed to halt catastrophic hemorrhage within seconds of application. Beneath its adhesive polymer backing lies a layered matrix of synthetic fibrinogen accelerators, vasoconstrictor microspheres, and a pressure-reactive foam substrate that expands on contact with blood to physically occlude wound channels. Once slapped onto a wound site, the patch reads ambient moisture and temperature to calibrate its release rate, delivering a cascade of clotting agents tuned to the severity of bleeding detected.

What distinguishes the Surge Patch from cheaper field dressings is its dual-action chemistry: while the outer layer seals surface tissue, a secondary sublayer releases a mild nerve-dampening compound that reduces pain signaling at the wound site without impairing motor function. This allows a wounded operator to remain combat-capable for an additional window of roughly twenty to forty minutes before the analgesic wears off and true triage becomes unavoidable. The patch's bright crimson packaging — a Lazarus Pharmaceuticals trademark — is instantly recognizable in low-light environments.

The Surge Patch is a staple of street-level fixers, mercenary teams, and anyone who operates in environments where a trauma surgeon is not an option. Corporate security details carry them as standard-issue backup. In the undermarket, counterfeit versions circulate widely, often using degraded fibrinogen compounds that cause delayed clotting failure hours after application — a known hazard that has earned the fakes the nickname 'false stamps.'

specifications.activation: Peel-and-press, self-activating on contact with biological fluid
specifications.wound_size_rating: Effective on lacerations and punctures up to 6cm diameter
specifications.shelf_life: 36 months sealed, 6 hours once packaging is broken

tactical_use: Applied one-handed under fire to arrest bleeding on limbs, torso, or neck. Operators are trained to apply and immediately re-engage rather than stop for extended first aid. The analgesic layer is specifically valued for maintaining trigger discipline after injury. Not suitable for internal bleeding or crush injuries — field medics use it as a stabilizer before more comprehensive treatment.
cultural_context: The Surge Patch has become something of a cultural shorthand in GLMZ's underclass for self-reliance in the absence of institutional care. Wearing a used patch wrapper as a wristband is a minor street affectation among gang members and runners — a signal that you've taken damage and kept moving. Lazarus Pharmaceuticals leans into this image in their street-level marketing, using the tagline 'You don't stop.' Corporate HR departments quietly bulk-purchase them for 'off-the-books' security operations, keeping no medical records attached.
known_users: The Patchwork Boys (GLMZ gang, known for visible patch-wrapper jewelry)
story_hooks: A batch of counterfeit Surge Patches with delayed clotting failure has entered circulation in the Underbelly — someone is deliberately seeding them into medic supply chains, and bodies are turning up hours after apparently successful field treatment.

Lazarus Pharmaceuticals is quietly recalling a specific lot number after discovering a manufacturing error causes the nerve-dampening compound to persist for days rather than hours, leaving users with partial numbness — but the recall notice hasn't reached the street.

A player character finds a used Surge Patch at a crime scene with a rare chemical marker indicating it came from a corporate black-site medical locker — evidence that a 'civilian' incident was actually a sanctioned operation.
related_entities: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Adrenal Phantom Graft — 'The Surge'

physical_description.visual_profile: A rectangular medical patch with a glossy crimson polymer face, slightly convex to suggest internal pressure from the reactive substrate beneath. The surface has a subtle holographic safety pattern that shifts when viewed at angles—anti-counterfeit measure. Edges are beveled and sealed with a transparent adhesive margin. Aesthetically positioned between clinical precision and street-level practicality.
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight at 38g—easily pocketable, designed to be carried in kit rigs, emergency pouches, or tactical vests without burden
physical_description.primary_material: Polymer-laminate housing with embedded synthetic fibrinogen matrix and vasoconstrictor microspheres; pressure-reactive foam substrate core
physical_description.finish: High-gloss crimson outer face with embossed Lazarus Pharmaceuticals script logo; matte backing strip for adhesion readiness
physical_description.color_scheme: Trademark Lazarus crimson (emergency red) as primary; silver holographic safety overlay; charcoal gray adhesive strip on reverse
physical_description.interface_elements: Peel-back adhesive tab (labeled with application arrows in white ink), temperature-sensitive indicator strip along left edge (turns blue when within optimal application window), small data matrix code for batch tracking on lower right corner
distinctive_features: Holographic anti-counterfeit pattern that cycles through blue-green iridescence
Embossed Lazarus Φ symbol in center, indicating pricing tier and authenticity
Dual-layer visual thickness suggesting internal chemistry complexity
Rounded corners and beveled edges for rapid blind application in field conditions
Faint residual texture from underlying foam matrix visible through translucent outer layer
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals logo (serif 'L' with pharmaceutical cross), batch number, expiration date, data matrix code, regulatory compliance marks (GLMZ medical authority stamp), and small printed warning about counterfeit detection
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and sealed in retail—glossy surface reflects light sharply. In field use: adhesive tab partially peeled, patch affixed to wound site with slight darkening at contact edges as blood activates the foam substrate
